feedback.finish: Ancient Greek philosophers and scientists made many important discoveries, and their ideas still influence modern thinking today.

atoms.text: Socrates was an ancient Greek philosopher known for his method of questioning everything to seek the truth. During his life, he was declared the wisest man alive!
Plato, a student of Socrates, founded the first western university.
In this university, Plato’s student, Aristotle, studied almost all fields of science and has shaped many modern ideas.

instruction.text: Work out which quote comes from which philosopher.

atoms.a: Socrates questioned everything, even his own knowledge.
Plato thought that true strength comes from controlling your desires and emotions.
atoms.b: “The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.”
atoms.c: Plato: “The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.”

atoms.a: Aristotle believed that our daily actions make us who we are.

atoms.b: Among the Greeks, there were many important ((++mathematicians magicians)). The most famous, Archimedes, used mathematics to solve real-life problems.
Archimedes supposedly made one of his most important ((++discoveries paintings)) in the bathtub.

atoms.b: Archimedes realised that the volume of an object can be ((++measured heard)) by submerging it and seeing how much the ((++water plastic)) rises, or is displaced.
When he worked this out, he is believed to have shouted in ((++triumph disappointment)), jumped out of the bath and run naked through the streets!
